heroHeadline: Trump Brokers Russia-Ukraine 3-Day Ceasefire on Victory Day; Iran MOU Deadline Passes — Day 70 of US-Iran War; 162 UAP Files Released
heroSubtitle: On May 9, 2026, President Trump announced a major diplomatic breakthrough: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a 3-day ceasefire (May 9–11) and a 1,000-for-1,000 prisoner exchange on Russia's Victory Day — with Zelensky and Putin's adviser Ushakov both confirming the deal, which Trump called potentially 'the beginning of the end' of Europe's most devastating conflict since WWII; broader peace talks were set for Geneva the week of May 12. Simultaneously, Day 70 of the US-Iran war passed without a formal Iranian response to the one-page peace MOU whose Rubio-set deadline had expired — Iran's FM confirmed it had 'strongly rejected' some terms but Pakistan's intermediary channel remained active; the ceasefire held technically with 22,500 mariners still trapped on 1,550+ vessels, Brent crude near $103–109/bbl, and Trump's threat of 'one big glow' hanging over Tehran. In a separate major announcement, the Department of War released 162 declassified UAP/UFO files (120 PDFs, 28 videos, 14 images) spanning 1948–2026 via the new war.gov/UFO portal — including Apollo mission photos and astronaut transcripts — as part of the PURSUE declassification program Trump signed in 2025. Kevin Warsh's full Senate floor vote as Fed Chair and the $72B ICE/CBP reconciliation bill remain scheduled for the week of May 11, before Jerome Powell's May 15 departure.
